flat_front_chain_stages.name: s01_image_cast
flat_front_chain_stages.description: Cast pixel_values to the vision tower dtype.

flat_front_chain_stages.name: s02_vision_encode_or_prune
flat_front_chain_stages.description: Run the active vision path: original encode, attention-score encode, or early-prune encode.

flat_front_chain_stages.name: s03_pruning_position_prepare
flat_front_chain_stages.description: Prepare position ids before sequence pruning. Zero for non-pruned baseline.

flat_front_chain_stages.name: s04_apply_pruning
flat_front_chain_stages.description: Apply token keep mask to image embeds and sequence tensors. Zero for non-pruned baseline.

flat_front_chain_stages.name: s06_scatter_image_embeds
flat_front_chain_stages.description: Write image embeddings into image-token positions.

flat_front_chain_stages.name: s07_scatter_proprioception
flat_front_chain_stages.description: Write proprioception embeddings into proprioception-token positions.

flat_front_chain_stages.name: s08_attention_mask_to_device
flat_front_chain_stages.description: Move attention mask to the model device.

flat_front_chain_stages.name: s09_position_and_moe_index
flat_front_chain_stages.description: Prepare position encoding and MoE token grouping.

flat_front_chain_stages.name: s10_action_initialization
flat_front_chain_stages.description: Initialize noisy action and write initial action embeddings.

flat_front_chain_stages.name: s12_prefill_action_head
flat_front_chain_stages.description: Run the first action head projection after prefill.
